name: Coldbreak HydroSeal Rain Trouser — Vented Cut
description: Slim-cut waterproof rain trousers in slate charcoal with taped seams and ankle cinches to seal over boots during Lake Michigan downpours. Side-zip vents run from thigh to knee for heat management in humid summer storms. A reinforced channel runs along the outer left leg to accommodate basic prosthetic or exoskeletal hardware.
functionality: Waterproof leg coverage with prosthetic-channel seam and ankle-seal over boots; vented for humid conditions.
what_it_says: Practical and presentable — this person navigates outdoor commutes without looking like they surrendered to the weather.
worn_by: Tier-3 office workers with outdoor routes
story_hooks: The prosthetic channel is factory-standard but someone has modified it with aftermarket padding — whoever wore these before had a non-standard limb.
Found in a locker at a Tier-3 transit hub with a name scratched out on the waistband tag.
